source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Prioritizing important tasks, sitting during activities when possible, and spreading tasks throughout the day rather than completing everything at once","B":"Avoiding any modification to the client's usual daily routine, since pacing is not generally considered helpful for this particular population","C":"Completing all household tasks as quickly as possible without taking any breaks at all throughout the entire day","D":"A concept generally considered to carry fairly little relevance to how heart failure symptoms are managed on a day-to-day basis"}}
source_row.rationale: Energy conservation techniques for a client with heart failure and fatigue include prioritizing important tasks, sitting during activities when possible (such as while preparing meals), and spreading tasks throughout the day rather than completing everything at once, helping manage limited energy reserves.
source_row.source_name: AHA — Energy Conservation Strategies in Heart Failure
